name: [SLO burn] AdvisorChat p95 latency > 3s (fast burn)
message: AdvisorChat p95 turn latency is breaching the 3s SLO. Fast-burn (5m) window. @slack-advisorchat-oncall

name: [SLO burn] Gateway error ratio > 2% (error budget)
message: Gateway error ratio exceeds 2% of requests over 15m; error budget burning. Check gateway.request.errors by error_category. @slack-platform-oncall

name: [TTC] Telemetry freshness lag > 15m
message: The SLI pipeline is processing traces that are more than 15 minutes old. Dashboards may be stale even though they render. Check Langfuse export and pipeline scheduling. @slack-platform-oncall

name: [TTC] Pipeline stalled - no records read
message: The SLI pipeline has read zero records in 20m. This is a BLIND SPOT: absence of workload metrics may be a pipeline outage, not real quiet. @pagerduty-platform

name: [TTC] Export health - OTLP export failing
message: The SLI pipeline failed to export at least one window to the collector. Metrics are being computed but not delivered. @pagerduty-platform

name: [TTC] Cost completeness - missing-cost records rising
message: More than 5% of processed records are missing cost data. Spend attribution and chargeback are under-counting (regulated cost governance risk). @slack-finops

name: [Cost/Reliability] Runaway agent - completion:prompt token ratio > 3
message: A route is emitting far more completion than prompt tokens (ratio > 3), the signature of a looping / runaway agent (see DATA_ANALYSIS.md F1). Investigate per-conversation token growth and step caps before spend compounds. @slack-platform-oncall

name: [MGC] Unknown-dimension spike - ungoverned team/route/model
message: A governed dimension is folding many values to 'other' - a new team/route/model likely launched without onboarding to the metric governance registry. Attribution is degraded until the vocabulary is updated. @slack-platform-oncall

name: [MGC] Cardinality health - series count above budget
message: Emitted workload series exceeded the governed cardinality ceiling (estimated_max_total_series() = 17920; see governance.py). A window above this is a dimension-explosion regression, not legitimate traffic - investigate before it reaches backend billing/limits. @slack-platform-oncall

name: [SLO burn] AdvisorChat availability - fast burn (1h/5m)
message: AdvisorChat is burning its 30-day availability error budget FAST: the 1h and 5m burn windows are both breaching (~14.4x). At this rate the monthly budget is exhausted in ~2 days. Page. @pagerduty-advisorchat

name: [SLO burn] AdvisorChat availability - slow burn (6h/30m)
message: AdvisorChat is burning its 30-day availability error budget slowly but persistently: the 6h and 30m windows are both breaching (~6x). Ticket and investigate before it escalates to a fast burn. @slack-advisorchat-oncall

name: [TTC] Cost integrity - invalid cost records detected
message: Malformed, negative, or non-finite cost values were rejected. Spend remains safe from corruption but source data integrity is degraded. @slack-finops

name: [TTC] Langfuse source retries elevated
message: The Langfuse source required repeated retries. Check rate limits, network health, and API capacity before freshness degrades. @slack-platform-oncall
